L82: # Cerumen as a Biomatrix for Canine Lymphoma Screening
L83: 
L84: ## Evaluate the cerumen biomatrix difference between healthy dogs and those diagnosed with multicentric lymphoma
L85: 
L86: ### Species
L87: 
L88: Dogs
L89: 
L90: ### Area of Study
L91: 
L92: Oncology
L93: 
L94: ### Purpose of Study
L95: 
L96: The purpose of this study is to valuate the cerumen biomatrix difference between healthy dogs and those diagnosed with multicentric lymphoma using headspace gas chromatography-mass spectrometry.
L97: ### Eligibility
L98: 
L99: Eligibility criteria are organized into two cohorts. Healthy dogs must have an unremarkable physical examination with no evidence of otitis and normal CBC, chemistry panel, and, when available, urinalysis. All screening diagnostics for healthy controls are covered by the study. Dogs with lymphoma must have a cytologic or histologic diagnosis of multicentric lymphoma and no evidence of ear infection on physical examination.
L100: Once a dog is confirmed as a healthy control or as a treatment-naïve lymphoma case, sterile ear swabs will be collected for sample acquisition.
L101: ### Exclusion
L102: 
L103: Exclusion criteria include any serious systemic illness, concurrent malignancies other than lymphoma, lymphoma subtypes that are not multicentric, and any prior treatment with prednisone, chemotherapy, or immunotherapies.
L104: ### Contact
L105: 
L106: For Further information about the study, contact Dr. Musser, Margaret (mmusser@iastate.edu)

L80: #  Clinical Trial Service
L81: 
L82: Clinical trials are studies that explore whether a procedure, treatment, diagnostic test, or medical device is safe and effective. Trials help answer questions, and the answers can benefit both animal and human health because of the many diseases common to both. By participating in a clinical trial, you and your pet are helping us advance the future health and well-being of animals and humans.
L83: The Lloyd Veterinary Medical Center has outstanding veterinary expertise through its board-certified clinicians, faculty, and technical staff in a state-of-the-art facility. We have expertise and experience in conducting clinical trials and analyzing the data.
